title: cli: `os meta delete` prints "✓ Metadata deleted" when the reset door removed nothing (`reset: false`), including a `--package` that holds no row of the item
body:
Filing gate ①, finding class (a): a reproducible defect with misleading user-visible text, measured at a public door. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `huangyiirene` · session `session_01YRp5z4kK6vgYkrdH97ztsy`, from #23350's dev report (PR #23475, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

`reach:` the public CLI door `os meta delete`, human output (the default `--format`). Measured by the #23350 dev with a one-off probe through the real oclif command against the real reset door, on PR #23475's head `7ec2fb6c7`. The probe was not kept.

**Reader who acts:** triage, to grade and route. Then the owning seat. The landing point is `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/delete.ts`, in `run()`'s human-output branch.

## What happens

- `os meta delete view nothing_here` prints `✓ Metadata deleted: view/nothing_here`, but nothing was removed. The same call with `--format json` answers `deleted: false`, from the door's `reset: false`.
- The same happens with PR #23475's new flag: `os meta delete view probe_v --package com.qa.gamma`, naming a package that holds no row of the item, prints `✓ Metadata deleted: view/probe_v`. The JSON output says `deleted: false`, and nothing was removed.

The human branch prints its success sentence without reading `result.reset`. An operator, or a script reading the human line, is told an item was reset when the door reset nothing.

## What done looks like

- When the door answers `reset: false`, the human output says so. For example: nothing to delete for `view/nothing_here` (and, with `--package P`, that P holds no row of it). The exit code follows whatever the command already declares for a no-op, measured and stated.
- A pin on each branch: `reset: true` prints the success line, and `reset: false` prints the no-op line. Each has a negative control.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included:
- Query `os meta delete human output says Metadata deleted when nothing removed reset false deleted false` → 3 hits: #21978, #5079 and #5276. All are closed, and all are other delete defects (the checksum compare, an overlay listing, a loader's silent skip). None is this.

Dedupe words: os meta delete human output reset false; Metadata deleted when nothing removed; meta delete deleted false sentence.
